subject: Post-demo MAP: DPA route, SCC module recommendation & security questionnaire kickoff
messages:
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
To: Emma Johnson <emma.johnson@veridianhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 27 Jan 2027 15:04:00 -0500
Subject: Post-demo MAP: DPA route, SCC module recommendation & security questionnaire kickoff

Hi Emma — great to meet earlier. Quick recap and proposed mutual action plan (MAP) from our discovery call so Legal/Security can pick up next steps: 

- Controller/Processor: From the call you indicated Veridian will be the Controller and Redwood the Processor for the integration we discussed. Please confirm that is correct.
- DPA & SCC preference: If you prefer, we can present a standard DPA that leverages the EU SCCs. Redwood commonly recommends SCC Module 2 (Processor as data importer) plus a Processor Annex for processing specifics, but we can adapt to your legal preference. Can you flag any mandatory SCC module on your side?
- SOC 2 / evidence: Attached is a one-pager SOC 2 summary (Redwood_SOC2_Summary_2026.pdf). We will upload the full SOC 2 Type II report to a secure drive once we have an NDA in place or an approved access list.
- Vendor security questionnaire: I can initiate the questionnaire and fill the first pass from our side. Who should be the technical contact at Veridian (name + email)? You mentioned legal@veridianhealth.com for contracting; please share the compliance contact too.

Proposed next steps (timeline):
1) You confirm controller/processor alignment and SCC module preference by EOD Thu 28 Jan.
2) Redwood legal (Marissa) will share a DPA draft for review (we aim to get the first draft to you by Fri 29 Jan).
3) Redwood security (Marcus) will start the security questionnaire and attach initial responses; we’ll request any clarifying evidence after your question set.

If that sounds good I’ll loop Legal + Security into the thread and drop the DPA draft.

Thanks —
Irene Choi
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
irene.choi@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0116
Redwood Inference

Attachment: Redwood_SOC2_Summary_2026.pdf (pdf, 120KB)
From: Emma Johnson <emma.johnson@veridianhealth.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
Cc: Legal Team <legal@veridianhealth.com>
Date: Thu, 28 Jan 2027 09:12:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Post-demo MAP: DPA route, SCC module recommendation & security questionnaire kickoff

Thanks, Irene — thanks for the clear MAP. A few clarifications from our side: 

- Controller/Processor: Confirmed — Veridian Health is the Controller for patient-facing datasets; Redwood will be Processor for model inference and telemetry.
- SCC module: Our legal team prefers the Module 2 path with processor-specific addenda if possible (sounds like the same as your recommendation).
- DPA redlines: We will want to review a DPA draft and will likely circulate internal redlines through legal@veridianhealth.com. Please include a section about subprocessor notification timelines and data deletion on termination.
- SOC 2: We need the full SOC 2 Type II report and the attestation letter. NDA is not necessary for initial review but we will request secure transfer.
- Questionnaire: Please start the vendor security questionnaire. Primary security/compliance contact here is: Noah Patel (noah.patel@veridianhealth.com). He’ll coordinate technical evidence.

Can you also confirm if Redwood supports:
  * Data segregation by tenant (logical)
  * Logging retention windows and exportability (we have a 7-year retention policy in some cases)

Emma
Director, Legal & Compliance
Veridian Health

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Emma Johnson <emma.johnson@veridianhealth.com>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 28 Jan 2027 11:30:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Post-demo MAP: DPA route, SCC module recommendation & security questionnaire kickoff

Hi Emma / Irene — looping in Legal to keep things moving. Thanks for confirming controller/processor alignment. A few items from Redwood Legal: 

1) DPA approach: We will share an editable DPA draft (attached: Redwood_DPA_Draft_V1.docx). Our usual approach for EU customers is to adopt the SCC Module 2 route and include a Processor Annex that calls out subprocessors, data categories, purpose and deletion timelines. We can accept reasonable redlines on subprocessor notification windows; please point to specific clauses you want changed.

2) Subprocessors: We will attach a current subprocessor list to the DPA package and offer a 30-day notice for new subprocessors by default; if Veridian requires a longer notice window we can discuss.

3) Data residency & retention: We need to confirm the residency requirement (if any). If Veridian requires EU-only residency we can offer regionally pinned deployments as a Dedicated/Private option — that’s typically a contract-level commitment.

4) Next steps & timeline:
  - Thu 28 Jan: Emma to confirm SCC Module 2 acceptance (noted).
  - Fri 29 Jan: Redwood to send editable DPA (attached) and secure link for SOC2.
  - Mon 01 Feb: Security (Marcus) to populate initial questionnaire responses and request any missing evidence.

Please review the DPA and send targeted redlines. Once Noah confirms the questionnaire owner we’ll coordinate technical evidence transfer.

Regards,
Marissa Cole
Head of Legal Operations, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai

Attachment: Redwood_DPA_Draft_V1.docx (docx, 48KB)
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Noah Patel <noah.patel@veridianhealth.com>, Emma Johnson <emma.johnson@veridianhealth.com>
Cc: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 28 Jan 2027 15:45:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Post-demo MAP: DPA route, SCC module recommendation & security questionnaire kickoff

Hi Noah / Emma — Marcus from Redwood Security. I started the security questionnaire and attached the initial pass (Redwood_Security_Questionnaire_Response_v0.1.pdf). A few quick notes and open items: 

- Tenant separation: Logical multitenancy with strict namespace isolation, per-tenant encryption keys are available for Dedicated/Private deployments; hosted customers use per-customer key namespaces with RBAC.
- Logging retention: Application and access logs are retained for 90 days by default on hosted; retention can be extended for Dedicated/private with contract terms. Export is available via secure S3 replication or log streaming. If Veridian needs 7-year retention we recommend a Dedicated deployment or archive export plan — we can provide an estimate for storage and egress costs.
- SOC2: We can provide the full SOC 2 Type II report via secure share once contractual access is agreed.

Open items for your team:
1) Please confirm whether you need per-tenant encryption key control (Y/N).
2) Deadline for the completed questionnaire — is Feb 8 acceptable?
3) Any specific evidence buckets (e.g., data deletion runbooks, SIEM exports) you want prioritized?

I’ll leave detailed legal language to Marissa but wanted to get technical answers started so there’s no blocker for procurement.

Thanks —
Marcus Lin
Principal Security Engineer, Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.ai

Attachment: Redwood_Security_Questionnaire_Response_v0.1.pdf (pdf, 420KB)
